temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems withdrawn and less vibrant than usual; when Jose asks, she says it is just personal stuff and thanks him, but does not give details. She says his offer to listen means a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose knows Patricia as usually vibrant and has no specific explanation for her current mood, though he suspects something may be troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Patricia is indeed dealing with personal matters, but she is not ready to share details; his support is welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is troubled by something personal and may need someone to listen, but she currently prefers not to discuss it in detail.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: concern, empathy, and cautious relief that she accepted his offer of support
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia if she chooses to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. She then confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and says financial planning or budgeting help could be helpful soon.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has an unspecified personal problem; she appreciated Jose's willingness to listen but had not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: The personal issue includes significant financial stress, and Patricia is receptive to discussing budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially overwhelmed and open to help or support; Jose can offer practical financial discussion when she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: concern, empathy, and a desire to be helpful
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss budgeting and financial planning with Patricia when she feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia reassures Jose that bringing up financial planning was not prying; she says she is grateful and that it is good to have someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries that Patricia may think he overstepped his boundaries by raising her finances, even though he meant to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Patricia explicitly says he was not prying and that she is grateful for his offer; his support is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: His concern and help are appropriate and appreciated as friendship, though he should continue respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: worry or guilt before the conversation, then relief and reassurance afterward
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while respecting her privacy and boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds politely but without sharing details: she says everything is good and she plans a quiet weekend at home. She thanks Jose and says she will keep his offer in mind. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and has said she is grateful, but he is uncertain how much she wants him involved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Patricia appreciates his concern but seems to prefer privacy and handling her issues herself; her non-detailed response signals a boundary.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his friendship and support, but she wants privacy and independence; Jose should not push for details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: respectful concern, warmth, and slight caution
temporal_state_chain.intention: Remain available and check in lightly while giving Patricia space.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks Jose for checking in, and tells him his support is really great. Jose continues to maintain a supportive presence at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately; Jose should stay supportive without prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Patricia is managing her situation and values his supportive check-ins; she does not indicate a need for more active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and appreciates low-pressure support; Jose can continue friendly check-ins while respecting her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue being a supportive presence and offer small practical help, such as coffee or a listening ear, without overstepping.
